What this app does, and what it cannot do for you.
A VPN forwards your traffic through a server you choose and encrypts it between this device and that server. It does not make you anonymous, and the sites you visit still see your requests.

Whichever server you connect to can see the address you are connecting to and the volume of your traffic. This app makes no no-logs claim, because there is no operator here to make one. A VPN is not antivirus, and it does not hide you from the network owner entirely.
There is no bundled server fleet, no free unlimited exit and no subscription in this app. You supply a WireGuard configuration or run your own gateway. Nothing is purchased or enrolled by continuing.
